session_expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.

totp_required.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
totp_required.body_admins: This workspace requires TOTP for administrators. Turn it on to continue; it takes about a minute.
totp_required.body_everyone: This workspace requires TOTP for every user. Turn it on to continue; it takes about a minute.

link.account: Account @{{username}}. Choose a password of at least 12 characters; a long passphrase works best.
link.password_saved: Password saved. Your account uses two-factor authentication: enter the code from your app or a backup code.

login.title: Sign in
login.code_hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
login.credentials_hint: Use the credentials your administrator gave you.
login.forgot: Forgot your password or lost your device? An administrator can reset it from the server.

setup.title: Set up your workspace
setup.description: Create the administrator account. To prove you control this server, enter the code shown in its console.
setup.code_hint: With Docker: docker compose logs api. It works only once.
setup.next: Next, you'll be asked to turn on two-factor authentication (TOTP) with your authenticator app.

account.qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
account.new_password_mismatch: The new password and its confirmation don't match
account.password_changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
account.totp_description: A 6-digit code from an app such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy, on top of your password.
account.backup_intro: Save these backup codes in your password manager. Each one works only once if you lose your device, and they won't be shown again.
account.disable_intro: To turn it off, confirm your password. If you just changed phones, turn it off and enroll it again.
account.step_scan: 1. Scan the code with your app.
account.step_key: 2. Can't scan it? Enter this key:
account.step_code: 3. Enter the code the app shows.
account.password_description: At least 12 characters. A long passphrase beats odd symbols. Changing it signs out your other sessions.
